transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, what got me to come in is my eating has been really all over the place. Some days I just forget to eat meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight tearing through takeout and snacks. It kind of scared me how uneven it’s been.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

I haven’t really tracked the number closely, but my appetite’s been changing a lot. Some days I’ll barely eat or forget meals, and then other nights I’m up late eating a bunch of takeout or snacks. It’s been uneven enough that it worried me.
Do you worry about gaining weight when you think about your eating habits?
Not really, no. I’m not sitting there worried about gaining weight. It’s more that the pattern feels off—like skipping meals and then eating a lot later.
Do you ever feel guilty after eating?
Not really. I mean, maybe I feel annoyed with myself sometimes because it’s not a normal routine, but I wouldn’t say I feel guilty after eating.
Do you ever feel like you can't stop eating once you've started?

Yeah, sometimes. It’s not every time I eat, but there are nights where once I start with takeout or snacks, especially late after midnight, I just keep going. It feels like my eating’s been all over the place—some days I forget meals completely, then other nights I’m tearing through food.
Do you usually eat more when you're feeling stressed or emotional?

Yeah, kind of. I don’t know if it’s exactly stress or emotions every time, but when things feel off I’ll either forget to eat all day or then later, usually after midnight, I’m just tearing through takeout and snacks. That’s honestly one of the things that made me think something wasn’t right.
How often do you have nights where you tear through food like that?

It’s not every night, but often enough that it bothered me. Like, I’ll go a day barely eating or forgetting meals, and then some nights after midnight I’m just going through takeout and snacks. That back and forth is honestly part of what scared me into coming in.
Do you feel like you're in control when you're eating late at night and having a lot of food?

Not really, no. It feels like once I start, especially late after midnight, I just keep grabbing more takeout or snacks. It’s not every night, but the way I can forget meals some days and then eat like that other nights is what scared me.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop yourself from eating when you have these late-night episodes?

Yeah, it feels that way sometimes. Like once I start eating that late, I’m not really thinking “okay, stop now.” I’ll just keep going through whatever takeout or snacks I have. And then other days I’ll barely eat at all, so the whole thing just feels really out of whack.
How many times a week do you have these episodes where you feel like you can't stop eating once you've started?

Maybe a couple times a week? It’s not every night. Some days I’ll forget meals completely, and then on other nights—usually after midnight—I’m tearing through takeout and snacks. That back and forth is what really scared me.
Do you feel like you're eating much more quickly than usual during those late-night episodes?

Yeah, sometimes. I don’t know if I’m timing it, but it feels like I’m just tearing through the food, especially after midnight with takeout or snacks. Then other days I’ll realize I barely ate at all, so it’s been really all over the place.
Do you have these episodes where you feel like you can't stop eating more than three times a week?

I don’t think it’s more than three times a week. It’s more like some nights after midnight I’ll tear through takeout or snacks, but then other days I forget meals completely. That back and forth is what’s been worrying me.
Do you feel like you have no control over what you're eating during those late-night episodes?

Yeah, in those moments it feels pretty out of control. Like I’ll start with takeout or snacks after midnight, and then I’m just going through it without really thinking. It’s weird because other days I’ll barely remember to eat at all.
Do you have these episodes where you feel like you can't stop eating at least once a week?

Yeah, I’d say it happens around once a week, maybe some weeks a little more. The eating is just all over the place — some days I forget meals, and then other nights after midnight I’m tearing through takeout or snacks. That’s part of what scared me enough to come in.
Do you feel guilty or self-critical about your eating after one of these late-night episodes?

Yeah, I do. Afterward I get really down on myself. It turns into me replaying every mistake I’ve made with those Providence accounts at work, thinking I blew my whole future, like I’m useless and everybody there can see it.
Do you feel guilty or self-critical immediately after these episodes of eating late at night?

Yeah, pretty much right after. I start beating myself up, and my mind goes straight to work—like replaying every mistake I’ve made with those Providence accounts and thinking I’ve ruined everything. I feel useless, like everyone at work can see I’m failing.
Do you think you're consuming a lot more calories on the nights you tear through takeout and snacks compared to your normal meals?

Yeah, on those nights it definitely feels like a lot more than a normal meal. I’ll skip or forget meals some days, and then after midnight I’m just tearing through takeout and snacks, so it’s kind of all over the place.
During those late-night episodes, do you think you're eating a large amount of food in a relatively short period of time?

Yeah, I think so. It’s not like a normal dinner — some days I’ll barely eat or forget meals, and then after midnight I’m eating a bunch of takeout and snacks pretty fast. That’s honestly part of what scared me into coming in.
Do you think you're eating an unusually large amount of food during those episodes where you feel like you can't stop eating?
Yeah, I think so. It feels unusually large to me—like I’ll miss meals earlier, then after midnight I’m going through takeout and snacks way more than I normally would. That’s part of what worried me.
Do you feel like you're unable to control how much you eat during those late-night episodes?

Yeah, that’s what it feels like. Some nights I’m not really planning to eat that much, but after midnight I’ll just start going through takeout and snacks, and it’s hard to stop. Other days I forget meals completely, so my eating just feels really out of control and all over the place.
